claims.text: Cybersecurity risks identified through TARA shall be treated to an acceptable level.

claims.text: Cybersecurity risk values (1-5) shall be assigned based on impact rating and attack feasibility.

claims.text: A cybersecurity case shall provide the argument that cybersecurity risks are treated to an acceptable level.

claims.edition_as_cited: ISO/SAE 21434:2021 — Road vehicles — Cybersecurity engineering
claims.text: Continuous cybersecurity monitoring shall detect vulnerabilities and incidents post-deployment.

claims.edition_as_cited: ISO/SAE 21434:2021 — Road vehicles — Cybersecurity engineering
claims.text: Cybersecurity requirements shall be specified for the component.

claims.text: The safety impact of each threat scenario shall be assessed using ISO 26262-3 severity classes.

claims.edition_as_cited: ISO 26262:2018 — Road vehicles — Functional safety
